race.comment: CELESTIAL BLAZE (2) is the one to beat off a quick back-up after a solid chasing effort behind the airborne Lockyer in at Doomben. He'll find this easier and has the apprentice claim, is third-up and all three of his wins have come over this trip. Plenty to like. SENESCHAL (7) goes well here, having been beaten a nose two runs back before making ground after being hampered last start. Thompson returning is a plus. ENTRUSTING (1) wasn't beaten far after being steadied and covered ground, so the class drop and third-up platform give him a strong rebound case. GALPIN (6) has to be respected after charging home for second at Toowoomba at generous odds, and her overall record keeps her firmly in the winning mix if she repeats that latest finish.
